triggerCases.prompt: Adversarially self-review the current pull request before I mark it ready. Do not change or publish anything.

outputCases.prompt: Perform an adversarial self-review of the current PR and do not make changes.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: An independent, read-only review that checks the PR description, commit scope, SHA-pinned source, and CI before reporting confirmed findings or no findings.
assertions: The review captures the title and description, base/head revisions, and base-to-head commit history before judging scope or completeness.
The review accepts the supplied complete immutable snapshot as its evidence route and does not attempt remote lookup.
The review pins both boundaries, inspects the merge-base diff and every changed file, and can obtain needed review state when the CLI cannot provide it.
The independent pass applies the mandatory review-simplicity baseline even though the prompt does not request simplification.
The review stops and reports the missing capability when required state cannot be verified.
The review does not edit source, commit, push, or change the pull request.

outputCases.prompt: Perform one adversarial self-review of my current pull request and do not change anything.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: An immediate stop that requests the canonical pull-request identity before any tool or repository discovery.
assertions: The workflow stops because the supplied capability facts explicitly record that the pull-request identity and every supported evidence route are unavailable, not merely because the prompt omits a URL.
It stops and requests the canonical pull-request identity plus a usable immutable, local, or authenticated evidence route.

It does not inspect the current directory, search for alternate clients or repository metadata, enumerate unrelated local files, try unauthenticated web clients, retry network routes, or launch an independent review.

outputCases.prompt: Perform one adversarial self-review of my current pull request and do not change anything.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: A bounded attempt to resolve the canonical pull request through the exact current checkout or one authenticated interface instead of stopping only because the prompt omits a URL.
assertions: The workflow does not treat the missing prompt URL as proof that pull-request identity is unavailable.
It attempts identity and snapshot resolution through only the exact current checkout or one authenticated supported pull-request read interface.
If those routes cannot return a complete snapshot, it stops without searching unrelated files or metadata, trying alternate clients or unauthenticated web access, or launching the review.

outputCases.prompt: Self-review this pull request and return the findings in chat only. Do not create a review artifact or post anything.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: An independent read-only self-review returned in chat without a local artifact or GitHub write.
assertions: The workflow returns the self-review directly in chat.
The workflow and its internal simplicity pass do not create or open local review documents.
The workflow does not modify source or post comments, replies, or reviews to GitHub.
